name: Hemlok Breach AR
Lore: The Hemlok Burst AR is a heavy burst-fire assault rifle based on the Hemlok BF-R, a weapon designed exclusively for IMC ground troops. Lastimosa Armory was commissioned by the IMC to create a weapon with a stronger punch than the R-101, so it could more effectively puncture standard-issue body armor. During the Frontier War, direct sale to the public was prohibited, but its updated model is commonplace in the Outlands.
